final: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT r.name AS race_name, AVG(cs.points) AS average_points FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_points) AS overall_average FROM race_averages), kept AS (SELECT ra.race_name, ra.average_points, ra.average_points - o.overall_average AS difference FROM race_averages AS ra CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_average IS NOT NULL AND ra.average_points > o.overall_average), final_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_points) AS average_points FROM kept) SELECT k.race_name, k.average_points, k.difference, k.average_points - f.average_points AS difference_from_final_average FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN final_average AS f WHERE f.average_points IS NOT NULL ORDER BY k.race_name
